situation: A freelancer and a client negotiate repeat work — either can keep dealing (cooperate), squeeze the other (defect), or simply walk away to a safe outside option (loner) worth less than a good deal but more than a bad grind

players.name: Freelancer
players.note: Will keep working if treated fairly, but has other clients to fall back on

players.name: Client
players.note: Tempted to squeeze on price, but can also just hire someone else

rationale.R: a fair ongoing arrangement = steady value for both
rationale.T: squeeze once while they stay committed = a quick win
rationale.P: mutual squeezing = a grinding, low-trust relationship
rationale.S: keep delivering while they squeeze = underpaid and overworked
rationale.w: the relationship may be a one-off or a long retainer
rationale.noise: a missed deadline or a scope dispute misread as bad faith
rationale.sigma: the outside option — another client / another freelancer — pays less than a good deal but beats being ground down (P < σ < R)
